sources.note: Cusanuswerk's own page for the doctoral (Promotions) selection procedure - requirements, deadlines and procedure. Note: served under the /en/ path but the page content is in German.
Cusanuswerk's financial-funding page for doctoral scholars - monthly stipend amount, supplements and maximum duration.
Cusanuswerk homepage, independently confirms the next application deadline and identifies the awarding body.

awarding_body.detail: The page is on cusanuswerk.de, the awarding organisation's own domain, and presents itself as the Bischöfliche Studienförderung Cusanuswerk, matching the record's awarding body exactly.
awarding_body.quote: Die Bischöfliche Studienförderung Cusanuswerk ist das Begabtenförderungswerk der katholischen Kirche in Deutschland.

deadline.detail: The page states the registration deadline for the currently open cycle Verfahren I-2027 as Sunday, 1 November 2026, with the selection decision in March 2027 - exactly matching the record's deadline_label and deadline_date. Today (12 October 2026) the cycle is still open. The homepage independently repeats the 1 November 2026 closing date.
deadline.quote: Verfahren I-2027 (Auswahlentscheidung im März 2027) - Anmeldeschluss: Sonntag, 1. November 2026

eligibility.detail: Every distinct claim in the record's eligibility_summary is stated on the page: outstanding academic performance, interdisciplinary interest, social responsibility and voluntary engagement, membership in the Catholic Church with a lived Christian faith, university entrance qualification, and admission to doctoral study at a recognised university. Additional conditions not in the record: applicants from developing/emerging countries in Africa, Asia, the Middle East, Latin America or Eastern Europe are asked to apply via the KAAD first; international applicants need admission at a recognised German university and German at C1 level; there is a stated preference for applications from young parents.
eligibility.quote: Folgende Voraussetzungen müssen für die Teilnahme an den Auswahlverfahren des Cusanuswerks gegeben sein: herausragende fachliche Leistungen und interdisziplinäres Interesse; ausgeprägtes gesellschaftliches Verantwortungsbewusstsein, ehrenamtliches Engagement, Kreativität, Offenheit und Reflexionsvermögen; Mitgliedschaft in der katholischen Kirche ..., ein gelebter christlicher Glaube und die Bereitschaft, die Kirche mitzugestalten; Abitur oder Hochschulzugangsberechtigung, die zum Studium an einer staatlichen oder staatlich anerkannten Hochschule berechtigt

funding.detail: The award is a monthly stipend (Stipendium), granted independently of parental income, plus a research-cost flat rate and optional childcare, family, abroad and health-insurance supplements; maximum duration 3 years 6 months. This matches the record's funding_type 'Stipendium'; the record does not claim fully-funded or tuition coverage. The application page quotes a monthly total of 1,750.00 EUR plus a 100 EUR research allowance, while the funding page quotes 1,650.00 EUR (1,550 EUR stipend + 100 EUR research allowance, raised from WS 2025/26) - a minor internal inconsistency in the headline amount between the two official pages, immaterial to the record's claim.
funding.quote: Die Promotionsförderung wird finanziell elternunabhängig in Höhe von insgesamt 1.750,00 Euro gewährt, zzgl. einer Forschungskostenpauschale in Höhe von 100,00 €.

degree_levels.detail: The page covers doctoral study only ('Auswahlverfahren für Promovierende' / Promotionsförderung), matching the record's degree level PhD.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Verfahren I-2027 (Auswahlentscheidung im März 2027) – Anmeldeschluss: Sonntag, 1. November 2026
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Deadline 1 November 2026 (Sunday) is the registration deadline for Verfahren I-2027, selection decision March 2027; a second external round, Verfahren II-2027, closes Tuesday 1 June 2027 (decision October 2027). Alumni of Cusanuswerk's student funding apply on separate dates (1 February / 1 September). The /en/ URL serves German-language content. The two official pages differ slightly on the monthly amount (application page: 1,750.00 EUR plus 100 EUR research allowance; funding page: 1,650.00 EUR = 1,550 EUR + 100 EUR, raised from WS 2025/26); re-check the exact stipend figure next time. Non-German applicants effectively route via KAAD and need C1 German; record's eligibility wording does not capture this.

notes_for_reviewer: No conflicting claims found; the record can move to active. Optional editorial improvements for a human: the eligibility summary could mention that applicants from developing/emerging countries outside Germany are normally directed to the KAAD, that foreign doctoral candidates must hold admission at a German university with C1 German, and that the monthly stipend (confirmed 'Stipendium') is approximately 1,750 EUR including the research-cost allowance - though the awarding body's own two pages state the headline amount slightly differently.
